verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API docs confirm tips can be collected at checkout on the terminal, including a separate tip input screen before the signature and custom tip amounts. Configuring percentage presets or smart tip amounts is not shown anywhere in the evidence, and support rests on a single first-party mention. Missing for 10: configurable tip percentages, smart tip amounts, reader (not just Terminal) tipping evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
